title: Questionnaire Section D, Q22: quarter-arc sketch with stick-figure observer and horizon
description: Sighting questionnaire page (printed page 273) ending with Section D, question 22, which asks the witness to place an "A" on a curved line for the object's height above the skyline when first seen and a "B" when last seen. The blank figure is a quarter-circle arc labeled "Overhead" and "Horizon", with a small stick figure labeled "You" at the corner. Questions 18.2-21 above ask about the object's apparent size (pea to dirigible), height, distance, speed and how it disappeared.
